method: Actual shipped DOM/UI scripts with mocked Chrome APIs. General UI fixtures use about:blank; iframe and form navigation cases use synthetic HTTP origins served entirely through local Playwright routes. NOT installed-extension E2E. No policy changes or external requests.

tests.name: Rendered popup fits a 392x600 viewport with accessible scrolling
Popup mode, opening preference, pause and resume wire to runtime requests
Popup protection override/reset and settings button are functional
Home URL control captures and displays current fixture URL
Recovery can be re-enabled in strict mode without changing the saved home
Completed requests preserve controls disabled by the latest page state
Popup disables tab actions when the source tab has closed
Settings controls and normalized-origin add/remove are functional
Saving an existing rule replaces it rather than duplicating it
Settings JSON import uses validation and updates preferences
Invalid import shows actionable error
Reset confirmation restores defaults
Responsive settings renders without horizontal overflow at 390px
Onboarding, help and privacy screens render with support contact
DOM guard intercepts trusted nested link before page handlers
DOM guard captures Enter-generated trusted link activation
Known-unprotected DOM link stays trusted, unmodified and native
Ctrl DOM gesture is not intercepted
Shift DOM gesture is not intercepted
Alt DOM gesture is not intercepted
Meta DOM gesture is not intercepted
Middle DOM gesture is not intercepted
DOM native exclusion: blank
DOM native exclusion: download
DOM native exclusion: mail
DOM native exclusion: js
DOM top-document _parent link is handled as a top target
DOM top-document _parent GET form is protected
DOM top-document _parent POST form remains native
Cross-origin iframe _top fragment resolves against frame but is checked against top URL
Cross-origin iframe _top fragment is checked before the first snapshot arrives
Known-unprotected iframe top target stays a trusted native click
Readable matching top document keeps an iframe _top fragment natively trusted
Direct-child iframe _parent link and GET form reach top; POST remains native
Nested iframe _parent navigation stays in its immediate parent context
DOM same-origin policy distinguishes internal and external links
DOM composedPath finds open-shadow links
DOM delegation protects links inserted after initialization
DOM GET-form serialization preserves submitter and replaces action query
DOM form submit uses empty and invalid native overrides plus no-submitter GET
DOM POST submission is not intercepted or replayed
DOM password-containing GET form is left native
DOM externally associated password field keeps GET form native
DOM GET form honors inherited base target
DOM reinjection is idempotent; one gesture makes one request
Untrusted synthetic page clicks cannot trigger the guard
DOM snapshot broadcast activates a newly pinned tab without reinjection
Disconnected runtime keeps protected click cancelled, rather than replaying it
DOM guard rejects out-of-order protection snapshot
DOM guard rejects a snapshot for another document
DOM guard accepts a lower revision only for its exact same-document reset handshake
Popup routes destination preferences through tab-scoped messages
Per-tab focus preference does not mutate the global default
Default destination is editable in Settings
